description: This file defines the PagePreview class within the PdfSharp.Forms namespace, which provides a custom UserControl for previewing PDF pages in a Windows Forms application. It handles rendering, zooming, scrolling, and visual layout of a PDF page preview.

classes.name: PagePreview
classes.description: A Windows Forms UserControl that displays a PDF page preview, supporting zoom, scroll, and custom rendering via delegate.

methods.name: CalculatePreviewDimension
methods.description: Calculates the size of the preview page based on zoom level and control size.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders the PDF page into a Graphics object, applying transformations and invoking custom rendering logic.

methods.name: PaintBackground
methods.description: Paints the background and border of the preview control.

methods.name: SetScrollBarRange
methods.description: Adjusts the scrollbars based on the current virtual canvas and offset.
